messages:
Maya (CS): Morning team — kickoff for Nightingale Therapeutics onboarding. Quick ask: can we align owners for the first 30 days? Account signed yesterday, onboarding starts Monday 2026-04-13. My proposed success criteria: 1) API integration end-to-end, 2) baseline perf p50 <300ms, 3) pilot with 50 users in staging. Thoughts?

Jordan (SE): @Maya I can own API integration + sample app. Need their API key and network egress/IP allowlist. Can @Alex share a contact and any SSO constraints?

Alex (PM): Pinged their PM (clare@nightingale.com) and added a quick intro note. I also sent calendar invites for Mon/Tue kickoff slots. I'll drop contract/network notes into the customer drive after this thread.

Li (Dev): I'll take SDK + prompt templates. Will start a repo scaffold and aim to have an initial PR by EOW. Question: do we default to the quantized 4-bit profile or start with FP16 for parity testing?

Sam (Eng): I'll provision a Dedicated test pool (2x A10G) and set up a staging route. Plan to run perf baseline on Tue after integration. If we see memory pressure we'll try a lower-precision profile.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled — Kickoff meeting Mon 2026-04-13 10:00 PDT. Invites: maya@redwood.com, jordan@redwood.com, li@redwood.com, sam@redwood.com, alex@redwood.com, clare@nightingale.com. Link: https://cal.example/meeting/3312345678

Maya (CS): Two risks to capture now: potential S2 data residency requirement (they mentioned EU-only), and custom private model tuning request later in Q2. Proposed mitigations: prep Private deployment checklist and flag to Security + Solutions by Wed.

Jordan (SE): Noted — I'll add an allowlist/egress checklist and simple health-check endpoint for early detection. I'll also post a short runbook in #eng-oncall for the staging routes.

Maya (CS): Agenda I'll use in the kickoff:
```
- Intros + roles
- Success criteria + owners
- Integration checklist (keys, networking, SDK)
- Pilot timeline (0–30d) + milestones
- Risks & mitigations + escalation path
```

Alex (PM): LGTM :thumbsup: I'll include timeline slides and a high-level run of demos. After kickoff I'll send the 7-day and 30-day checklists.

Li (Dev): Quick note — if we start FP16 we'll need a small regression test matrix. I'll add that to the PR description.

Sam (Eng): I'll post the staging endpoint and perf baseline metrics in this thread after the Tue run.

Maya (CS): Perfect — thanks all. I'll follow up with the invite notes and the initial 7-day checklist by EOD today.
